themes.label: Fed Regime Change — Warsh Hiking Leg Confirmed; Bear-Flattening Accelerating
themes.stance: Hike landed; Warsh flagged inflation 'still too high.' 2Y at 4.74% — well above the 4.50% hiking-leg threshold and 30bp+ richer than prior read. 10Y-2Y compressed to 0.27 (from 0.41), bear-flattening on inflation/fiscal, not growth. 10Y through 5.00%. Leg-vs-one-off remains the key variant; Sep 29-30 FOMC is the next read. ZROZ UW stays highest-conviction call.
themes.tell: 2Y holding >4.50% confirms hiking-leg risk (press UW). Break below 4.10% revives cut trade (cover duration UW). Sep 29-30 FOMC hawkish guidance = press further; dovish tilt or hold signal = reassess leg thesis.

themes.label: BoJ Rate Hike — Japanese Capital Repatriation Draining UST Demand
themes.stance: BoJ hiked to a 31-year high (partly under US/Bessent pressure), making JGBs more attractive and repatriating Japanese capital away from Treasuries. This removes a marginal UST buyer into the Nov 5 Treasury refunding — a demand drain that amplifies the bear-flattening and term-premium impulse independently of US fiscal dynamics. Yen-supportive, carry-unwind risk elevated.
themes.tell: 10Y sustained >5.00% with a soft 30Y auction (tail >1bp) = repatriation/demand-drain thesis confirmed, press duration UW. 10Y back below 4.80% with strong auction demand = repatriation fear overdone, reassess. USDJPY breaking below ~140 with MOVE/VIX spike = carry unwind underway, cut equity beta fast.

themes.label: Core Inflation Trajectory — Services Sticky; Oil Passthrough Still Ahead
themes.stance: Core CPI re-accelerated to +0.29% MoM (Aug) on domestic services — the sticky leg is now home-grown, not purely oil-driven. WTI pulling back below $100 does not rescue duration; 'oil down = Fed pivots' reflex should be faded. M2 still climbing (~5% annualized). Aug data predates any oil passthrough, so that impulse is still ahead. TIPZ and IAU remain cleaner expressions.
themes.tell: Aug core PCE (Sep 30) ≥+0.3% MoM = services/oil passthrough arriving, extend inflation longs; ≤+0.2% = tactical fade signal. Sept CPI (Oct 14) ≥+0.3% = full passthrough confirmed, press duration UW and energy/gold. Two consecutive sub-0.2% prints = thesis inflects lower.

themes.label: Dual Choke Point Oil Shock — WTI Pulling Back; Geopolitical Floor Intact
themes.stance: WTI hit $107 (Sep 15) then slipped below $100 on Saudi supply hopes despite ongoing Houthi strikes on Saudi facilities. Momentum is stalling but no confirmed de-escalation — Trump's 'Iran wants a deal' comment vs. UN war-crimes report keeps a floor under crude. Trim acute tactical oil beta; retain structural XLE/refiner sleeve. Core inflation is now home-grown, so oil relief does not flip the inflation or duration thesis.
themes.tell: Brent sustained below $85 with confirmed dual-front de-escalation (Hormuz AND Red Sea tanker-routing data) = trim to structural sleeve only. WTI back above $100 on fresh supply disruption = re-press energy. Early-Oct OPEC+ supply increase = supply-side cap confirms pullback, not spike.

themes.label: Arsenal Depletion — Multi-Year Defense Restocking Mandate
themes.stance: Intact and broadening. Multi-theatre depletion: Iran strikes, Russia probing NATO airspace (Poland/Tusk warning of drone-strike plans), Houthis hitting Saudi facilities. Sep 30 FY27 deadline is a potential supplemental vehicle; Dem House probability ~89.5% (prediction market) makes funding timing, not demand, the risk. OW XAR, LMT, RTX, NOC.
themes.tell: Sep 30 defense supplemental introduced or passed = restocking thesis funded near-term. Prime contractor (LMT, RTX, NOC) order-book guidance raised on late-Oct earnings = demand confirmed. Simultaneous binding ceasefire across Iran/Hormuz, Ukraine, AND Red Sea = trim acute premium; multi-year thesis survives on global broadening.

themes.label: AI Trade Bifurcating — 5% Cost of Capital + Supply Wall Double-Hit Frothy Cohort
themes.stance: 10Y through 5.00% mechanically compresses long-duration AI multiples. OpenAI IPO supply wall (>$500B near-certain per prediction market) is an unpriced overhang on the cohort. Senate blocking of the data-center electricity-cost bill adds bipartisan regulatory friction as a slow-building overhang. Barbell tightens: hold margin-defended moats (MSFT, AMZN), cut vendor-financed/dilution-funded names harder. Hard reads: MSFT Oct 22, NVDA Nov 19.
themes.tell: 10Y sustained >5% = long-duration AI multiple compression accelerates, trim capex cohort harder. MSFT Oct 22: capex raised + gross margins intact = moat holds; margin warnings or capex guidance cuts = confirm de-rating, press short leg. OpenAI IPO pricing ≥$1T = cohort multiple re-rating risk fully active.

themes.label: Yen Carry Unwind Vol Tail — BoJ Hike Elevates Risk; Hedge Stays Live
themes.stance: BoJ hike to a 31-year high is a direct carry-cost shock; combined with soft broad USD (~118.2) and a global bond selloff, the carry-unwind tail is now more acute, not less. A disorderly unwind remains a stocks-and-bonds-down-together event. Soft dollar is net positive for gold and oil-exporter EM (EWZ/Petrobras). Retain EWZ as oil-exporter + soft-dollar + Brazil-election call distinct from broad EM.
themes.tell: USDJPY breaking below ~140 with concurrent MOVE/VIX spike = carry unwind underway, cut equity beta fast. USDJPY stabilizing above 145 with vol contained = hedge can be trimmed. Broad USD index sustained above 119 = soft-dollar EM condition breaks, revisit EWZ/EEM positioning.

themes.label: Consumer Squeeze — One-Month Rebound; Call Softened but Not Resolved
themes.stance: August retail +1.24% MoM nominal beat CPI (+0.40%) for a clean real-positive rebound (~+0.84% real), rebutting July's real-negative print. A resilient consumer removes the near-term recession release valve for duration longs and hands the Fed more cover to stay restrictive. One print doesn't flip the theme — hold discretionary UW pending a second real-positive (Sept retail). Homebuilders UW stays clean: housing starts fell to 1,275k (Aug) from 1,439k (Jun); 5% mortgage-adjacent yields do independent damage. Michigan recovering (55.2 vs 44.8 May low).
themes.tell: Sept retail (real, ~Oct 16): second consecutive real-positive = resolve squeeze thesis, cover discretionary UW. Real-negative reversal = squeeze reasserts, deepen UW. Michigan below 50 on a subsequent read = sentiment deteriorating, accelerates thesis. Oct 2 Sept payrolls weak with real-negative retail = recession-release-valve risk revives.

themes.label: Labor Market Softening — Thesis on the Ropes; Awaiting Oct 2 Confirmation
themes.stance: Aug payrolls +162k, U-rate 4.1% (cycle low), continuing claims fell to 1,730k (Sep 5) — well below the ~1.85M stress threshold. Labor market is giving the Fed full cover; hike tail, not cut trade, is the live risk. One strong print doesn't confirm reversal; Oct 2 is the deciding read.
themes.tell: Oct 2 Sept payrolls: second consecutive >100k with U-rate ≤4.1% = softening thesis resolved, drop from ledger. Continuing claims sustained above 1.85M = crack re-widens, upgrade back to inflecting. Weak Oct 2 print reverting to flatline = crack-not-collapse reasserts, upgrade status.
